findings.explanation: `cancellation_date` is selected as an input and its name suggests it may be recorded after the prediction moment. A name alone does not prove leakage.
findings.next_step: Record the decision time, source timestamp and lineage. Exclude it only if unavailable at prediction time; then run a safe-feature ablation.

records.statement: A suspicious name or high univariate AUC starts a semantic review; it does not prove leakage.
